title: Example 132: a refill counting periods from the epoch, found crediting a token for a nanosecond by the tool's own checker
description: Regression proof of net.terminalvalue.crosscut.ratelimit.TokenBucket#tokensAfter by the tool's own bounded model checker (--engine native) within the module's precondition as scope: the whole periods earned computed as nowNanos / periodNanos - lastNanos / periodNanos instead of (nowNanos - lastNanos) / periodNanos. Expected a violation at tokensAfter(tokens=0, lastNanos=1, nowNanos=2, periodNanos=2, capacity=1), 0 before and 1 after, found in the first search stage in about 3 s inline.
